Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

VCMoE 0.3.0

Fitting and convergence

  • The local-grid EM now stops on the penalized local objective it ascends (loglik - penalty), not on the unpenalized log-likelihood, which can stop on a flat stretch while the objective still climbs. Starts that met the stopping rule are preferred, and among them the one with the highest penalized objective is kept; if none met it, the best finite start is kept with converged = FALSE. loglik still reports the unpenalized log-likelihood. Default fits can therefore differ slightly from 0.2.0.
  • New vcmoe_refine() continues the local EM from a fitted solution with a tighter tolerance, keeping the labels. The default relative tol = 1e-5 can stop well before the local maximum in large samples; refining before inference usually makes the sandwich bread positive definite.
  • vcmoe_diagnostics() reports per grid point the stop reason, the last objective change, the selected start, whether an unconverged start reached a higher objective, label-alignment overrides and refinement.
  • Global label alignment that relabels a grid point against a confident match with its neighbour is flagged (alignment_override) with a warning.
  • Grid-parallel fitting: control$grid_subset, grid_seed, grid_warm_start and grid_init_locals, with vcmoe_merge_grid_fits() and vcmoe_grid_neighbor_inits(). Merged parts reproduce the serial fit exactly under per-grid seeds without warm starts. Merges can switch to label = "greedy".
  • Negative-Binomial theta ridges are scaled by the kernel mass of the grid point (negbin_theta_penalty_mass = "kernel"), so the fitted theta solves the estimating equation the sandwich differentiates. Objects from 0.2.0 are read with their original rule; strict inference on such fits with a theta ridge is blocked with a request to refit.
  • Known-label fits through control$fixed_membership.
  • Joint-path fits start by default from a mixture of experts without u dependence (joint_path_global_start = TRUE), which keeps component labels consistent along u. Joint-path fits can therefore differ from 0.2.0.

Generalized likelihood-ratio tests

  • vcmoe_glrt() now compares observation-level mixture log-likelihoods, with each coefficient path evaluated at the observation’s own u. The 0.2.0 local-grid statistic summed grid-point local likelihoods, which counts each observation about 1 / (grid spacing) times; its analytic p-values were far too small, and results computed with it should be recomputed. control$lambda_type = "fit_objective" reproduces the 0.2.0 scale.
  • Analytic calibration counts only the coefficient functions constrained under the null: the default C_const is now 1 (it was 2).
  • strict = FALSE is the default. Optimizer failures still block the test; a null fit that stopped at its iteration limit gives a p-value with a warning and null_converged = FALSE.
  • Joint-path null fits project constrained paths onto their equal-weight grid average by default (control$null_projection = "uniform"), the setting used in the validation of the analytic calibration; null_projection = "sample_weighted" restores the 0.2.0 weighting by nearest-grid observation counts.
  • Bootstrap refits follow the tested component, and for k >= 3 both components of a gating contrast. Draws whose null optimizer failed or whose null beats the full refit are excluded; bootstrap_counts reports the requested, successful and excluded draws.
  • GLRT and reduced-fit metadata changed: the criterion-matching entry was removed from settings, and theory_status, calibration_status and statistic_criterion take new values that describe the statistic used. Joint-path confidence-band metadata uses "joint_path_observed_local_likelihood_plugin".

Clustered observations

  • vcmoe_confband(fit, cluster = id) gives cluster-robust intervals for local-grid fits: CR2 with Bell-McCaffrey degrees of freedom by default (CR0, CR1 and CR3 are available), and finite-grid simultaneous bands from a studentized wild cluster bootstrap with Webb weights. Diagnostics report active and effective clusters, degrees of freedom and block reasons per grid point. control$path_tests = TRUE adds zero and constancy path tests, and control$path_sets bands over sub-paths.
  • New vcmoe_gene_screen() screens candidate covariates for expert associations in Negative-Binomial fits, with CR2 studentization, a shared wild cluster bootstrap, optional gating profiling of strong markers and Benjamini-Hochberg or min-p adjustment over the full candidate set.
  • predict() bounds Negative-Binomial theta to [negbin_theta_min, negbin_theta_max] before interpolating, as the likelihood does, so a stored unbounded value no longer gives NaN predictions.
  • Strict inference now blocks only the grid points that did not converge. Negative-Binomial eta-bound checks use only observations with positive kernel weight at the grid point.

VCMoE 0.2.0

CRAN release: 2026-07-15

Fitting engines

  • Adds stable single-response joint-path EM through vcmoe_fit(..., engine = "joint_path_em").
  • Keeps engine = "local_grid_em" as the default and preserves the 0.1.0 local-grid numerical path when engine is omitted.
  • Adds dense-grid cost guardrails, nearest-grid observation assignment, joint-path convergence traces, and optional progress logging.

Inference and selection

  • Makes analytic confidence bands available through the common fitted-object interface for both engines. Joint-path bands identify their local-likelihood sandwich plug-in scope and expose score-imbalance diagnostics.
  • Makes parametric bootstrap refits and bandwidth selection engine-aware.
  • Adds sample-weighted projected joint-path constrained-null fitting for GLRT and vcmoe_fit_reduced() while retaining the established local-grid BFGS null optimizer. Joint-path GLRT uses sample-level nearest-grid likelihood contributions and blocks failed or nonconverged null fits.
  • Changes the GLRT calibration default to "none". The statistic is available without a reference distribution; analytic Epanechnikov calibration is an explicit approximation, and parametric bootstrap calibration is engine-preserving.
  • Adds criterion, projection, constrained-MLE, calibration, and theory-status metadata to GLRT results. Analytic confidence bands now state whether their covariance target matches the fitted estimator and which shared-path and label uncertainties are excluded.

Scope

  • Version 0.2.0 remains a single-response package for Gaussian, Binomial, and Negative-Binomial models with 2 through 10 components.
